name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 8V — HTSOP
description: Cluster of surface-mount 8V LDO linear regulator ICs in the HTSOP package family using HTSOP-8-1EP footprints.
selection_hints: Select when requiring an 8V LDO linear regulator in an HTSOP surface-mount package.
Verify compatibility with the HTSOP-8-1EP_3.9x4.9mm_P1.27mm_EP2.4x3.2mm footprint.
Choose among parts such as BD80FC0WEFJ, BD80GA3WEFJ, and BD80GA5WEFJ.
avoid_when: A package family other than HTSOP or a non-SMD mounting style is required.
The target design requires a regulator specified for a voltage other than 8V.
